capabilities: Run JavaScript and TypeScript scripts from notes, commands, hotkeys, startup scripts or obsidian:// URLs
Load CJS/ES modules, TypeScript, JSON, npm packages, Node built-ins and WebAssembly with require() or requireAsync()
Turn scripts in a scripts folder into Obsidian commands and hotkeys
Run runnable code-button snippets inside notes
Share one helper module across other scripting plugins
disambiguation: Formerly named Fix Require Modules, it is a full scripting toolkit, not just a fix for require() calls.
extras: Formerly named Fix Require Modules; the internal plugin id fix-require-modules was kept for backward compatibility. Ships an interactive demo vault accessible via a command or GitHub. On mobile it requires iOS/iPadOS 16.4+ or Android System WebView 97+. Beta installs via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Enriches the scripting plugins you already use:
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run your own JavaScript, and scripting plugins each carry their own limited module loading that cannot be shared between them.
